title: Xanthe and the Choir
author: Juniper Coldharbour
blurb: Petra Nakamura, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
